name: camayoc_github_pr_current_state
description: github-activity Q1: the state pull request <repo>#<number> was left in by its LATEST pull_request.* activity (state, merged, head, draft, kind, time). Current state is a read-time judgment over append-only GitHubActivity records in the github window graphs; nothing stores it.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?pr ?kind ?at ?state ?merged ?head ?draft WHERE { GRAPH ?g0 { ?repo aegis:githubFullName "{repo}" . } GRAPH ?g1 { ?pr a aegis:GitHubPullRequest ; aegis:inGitHubRepository ?repo ; aegis:githubNumber ?n . } FILTER(STR(?n) = "{number}") GRAPH ?g { ?a aegis:aboutGitHubEntity ?pr ; aegis:githubEventKind ?kind ; aegis:occurredAt ?at ; aegis:githubState ?state . OPTIONAL { ?a aegis:githubMerged ?merged } OPTIONAL { ?a aegis:commitSha ?head } OPTIONAL { ?a aegis:githubDraft ?draft } } FILTER(STRSTARTS(?kind, "pull_request.")) } ORDER BY DESC(?at) LIMIT 1
